name: Muhammad I ar-Rashid
contribution: The third leader of the Husainid Dynasty and the ruler of Tunisia from 1756 until his death.

checks.lead: Muhammad I ar-Rachid (Arabic: محمد الأول الرشيد), commonly referred to as Rachid Bey (Arabic: رشيد باي ; 1710 – 12 February 1759) was the third leader of the Husainid Dynasty and the ruler of Tunisia from 1756 until his death. His son was Mahmud ibn Muhammad.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
